title: Andy: A Mathematical Agent for Rigorous Proof and Autonomous Research
abstract: arXiv:2608.15052v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Andy is an autonomous mathematical research agent that solves and verifies submitted problems, formulates new research problems, and constructs rigorous proofs. It separates proof generation from correctness evaluation and supports knowledge acquisition, targeted revision, and multistage verification. This paper illustrates the workflow using a published result on self-triggered impulsive consensus as a starting point. Andy formulates a global exponential leader-follower synchronization problem for delayed heterogeneous networks with switching communication topologies. The proposed hybrid control combines self-triggered impulses with execution delay and recovery-phase continuous feedback. After each delayed impulse, this feedback cancels the delayed error channel during a recovery window. Sufficient conditions for global exponential synchronization are established, and Zeno behavior is excluded for both the sampling and impulse sequences

translated_title: Andy：一个用于严谨证明与自主研究的数学代理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15052v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Andy 是一个自主数学研究代理，能够解决并验证提交的问题，提出新的研究问题，并构建严谨的证明。它将证明生成与正确性评估分离，支持知识获取、针对性修订和多阶段验证。本文以一个已发表的关于自触发脉冲共识的结果为起点，展示了其工作流程。Andy 提出了一个针对具有切换通信拓扑的延迟异构网络的全局指数领导-跟随同步问题。所提出的混合控制结合了带有执行延迟的自触发脉冲和恢复阶段的连续反馈。在每个延迟脉冲之后，该反馈在恢复窗口内抵消了延迟误差通道。建立了全局指数同步的充分条件，并排除了采样和脉冲序列的 Zeno 行为。
tldr: 本文介绍了自主数学研究代理 Andy，它能够生成和验证数学证明，并通过自触发脉冲与连续反馈相结合的混合控制，解决了延迟异构网络在切换拓扑下的全局指数同步问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Andy, an autonomous mathematical research agent that generates and verifies proofs, and solves a global exponential synchronization problem for delayed heterogeneous networks with switching topologies using a hybrid control combining self-triggered impulses and continuous feedback.
